chunks: And whatever was in it from Khālid ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ al-Khaffāf, I have narrated it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan al-Ṣaffār, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Muḥammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Khālid ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ al-Khaffāf.

key_terms.الصَّفَّارِ: Al-Ṣaffār; the well-known transmitter in the sanad/isnad.
key_terms.الْخَفَّافِ: Al-Khaffāf; an identifying nisbah for the narrator Khālid ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; an authorial statement indicating the route of narration.
key_terms.عَنْ: From; the transmission link used to connect narrators in the sanad/isnad.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Khālid ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ al-Khaffāf in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits narrations from Khālid ibn Abī al-ʿAlāʾ al-Khaffāf in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the precise line of transmission, which is essential in hadith sciences for identifying sources and evaluating reports.
